title: Great box!!
text: I loved the first toy & my kids were deeply engaged with it for hours. They were excited to get it (I realize this probably makes me seem like a shopaholic) but I had a couple of boxes delivered on the same day & couldn’t tell from the outside which was theirs. It would be really special if there were some sort of sticker on the outside so they could tell right away that their monthly box had arrived.
label: positive
